verdict.rationale: Apify's Actor framework provides local development tooling (CLI, Docker base images) and the open-source Crawlee library, which can run scraping code without the hosted cloud, but there is no evidence of an open-source, self-hostable version of the Apify platform itself (Actor execution engine, storage, scheduling) as a substitute for the cloud service. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting instructions/OSS release of the full platform, evidence of running Actors end-to-end outside Apify Cloud, and community confirmation of successful self-hosted deployments.
